title: ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio
description: ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio: ComfyUI browser workflows for generating video with audio from text, images and soundtracks.

input.name: Auto Download Adapters
input.description: Download the optional Ingredients BF16 models and IC-LoRA at startup; adds about 65 GiB.

input.name: Auto Download Models
input.description: Download missing required model files at startup. If disabled, all required weights must already exist on disk.

input.name: Backup Recheck Seconds
input.description: Seconds between backup reconciliation scans; runtime enforces a minimum of 10.

input.name: Backup Settle Seconds
input.description: Seconds to wait for output files to settle before upload.

input.name: Backup Source Dir
input.description: Local output directory watched by S3 backup.

input.name: Hf Home
input.description: Hugging Face cache directory on container storage.

input.name: Log Level
input.description: Template log-level setting. Current startup scripts do not read it; retained for template parity.

input.name: Ltx Default Aspect Ratio
input.description: Aspect ratio seeded into newly installed workflows: 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 1:1, or 21:9.

input.name: Ltx Default Duration
input.description: Requested duration in seconds for newly installed workflows; long clips require sufficient GPU memory.

input.name: Ltx Default Fps
input.description: Frames per second seeded into newly installed workflows.

input.name: Ltx Default Megapixels
input.description: Resolution target for newly installed workflows; the installer clamps dimensions to a 0.2–2.0 megapixel range.

input.name: Ltx Default Workflow
input.description: Packaged workflow filename without .json to open by default. Existing workflow files are preserved.

input.name: Realtime Backup
input.description: Enable automatic S3-compatible output backup. Configure a bucket and both credentials before enabling.

input.name: S3 Bucket
input.description: Destination bucket name. Replace YOUR_BUCKET before enabling backup.

input.name: S3 Endpoint Url
input.description: S3 API endpoint. Template defaults to DigitalOcean Spaces SFO3; use the endpoint for your storage provider.

input.name: S3 Force Path Style
input.description: Use path-style S3 bucket addressing when required by the storage provider.

input.name: S3 Prefix
input.description: Object-key prefix under the destination bucket.

input.name: S3 Region
input.description: S3 region used to sign requests.

input.name: S3 Session Token
input.description: Optional temporary S3 session token. Replace OPTIONAL_TEMPORARY_TOKEN with a Runpod Secret reference when using temporary credentials; placeholder means no token.

input.name: S3 Sse
input.description: Server-side encryption setting: none disables it; use AES256 or aws:kms:<key-id> as supported by your provider.

input.name: S3 Storage Class
input.description: Storage class passed to S3 uploads; STANDARD is the template default.

input.name: Attention backend
input.description: Attention backend used when the launch settings are first created. Existing user launch settings are preserved.
